title: Weighted approximate tangent planes are invariant under the similarity y ↦ ξ + t·y
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ, ξ, y ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0, P ≤ ℝ^N a linear subspace, and σ(w) := ξ + t·w. Then σ^{-1}(M) has weighted approximate tangent space P at y with respect to θ∘σ if and only if M has weighted approximate tangent space P at σ(y) = ξ + t·y with respect to θ (both in the sense of Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (ξ y : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)), 0 < t → (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n ((fun w : Euclidean N ↦ ξ + t • w) ⁻¹' M) (fun w : Euclidean N ↦ θ (ξ + t • w)) y P ↔ Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (ξ + t • y) P)
